method: Read the P2-D2 L2 gate, the P2-B rig, the global test setup and the on-disk gate root. Measured the real DSH module tree size and counted reparse points. Launched no heavy gate.

previousIncident.summary: During P2-D2 a local run exhausted C:, accumulated large disposable gate directories, created a baseline worktree containing a node_modules junction, ran a recursive cleanup that followed that junction, and damaged the main worktree's node_modules. Dependencies were restored with a frozen-lockfile install and key tests reran. The tracked repository was unaffected.
previousIncident.demonstrates: a clean Git tree does not prove the working environment is safe (§4)

measuredFacts.l2GateCopyMethod: cpSync(source, destination, { recursive: true, dereference: true })
measuredFacts.estimatedDiskPerL2Run: ~1 GB of dereferenced dependency copies, before sessions, SQLite and the world

defects.defect: the L2 gate allocates an owned root and never releases it
defects.source: scripts/trajectory_p2d2/l2-gate.mjs (no rmSync of owned.root; every exit via finish() → process.exit())
defects.consequence: every L2 run leaks ~1 GB; 22 roots / 5.13 GB already present

defects.defect: recursive cleanup does not inspect descendant reparse points
defects.source: scripts/trajectory_p2b/rig.mjs safeCleanup() checks only the top-level owned root
defects.consequence: a leaked root containing a node_modules junction can be traversed by rmSync(recursive)
defects.correction: C2 (no-follow descendant inspection + external sentinel test)

defects.defect: the L2 gate copies the whole DSH dependency tree twice per run with dereference:true
defects.consequence: ~1 GB per run; the disk-exhaustion source
defects.correction: C2 (safe shared-dependency configuration, or a controlled full-copy fallback with disk preflight)

defects.defect: the global test-hygiene sweep does not check for reparse points before deleting
defects.consequence: it deletes only palimpsest- prefixed temp dirs, so it is not the incident's cause, but it has no defence if such a dir contains a junction
defects.correction: C2 (documented; the sweep is left as-is because changing global hygiene is broader than this stage's scope, and its prefix rule already bounds it)

diskBudgetPreflight.requiredForHeavyGate: two DSH profile copies (~1 GB) + sessions + SQLite + git world + cleanup/logging overhead + conservative margin
diskBudgetPreflight.verdict: SUFFICIENT on F: (113 GB free), PROVIDED the gate runs on F: and C: is not the copy target
diskBudgetPreflight.note: C: is at 97% (7.1 GB free) and holds the gate root; the heavy gate must not target C:
